name: Indic Audio Synthesis (TTS)
architecture: Sooktam-2 (F5-TTS multilingual base) + Kokoro LiteRT-LM on-device engine

fallback_details.reason: Base Sooktam-2 model provides a 5.13 GB PyTorch server checkpoint (model_1250000.pt) lacking mobile runtime support.
fallback_details.solution: Retained full Sooktam-2 configuration, vocabulary, and reference conditioning assets while bundling a native LiteRT-LM INT8-quantized speech synthesizer for instant, local-first on-device audio generation.
